package tag

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// GetTagBySlug fetches tag by slug.
type GetTagBySlug struct {
	Tags repository.TagRepository
}

// Handle returns tag by slug.
func (uc GetTagBySlug) Handle(ctx context.Context, slug string) (*domain.Tag, error) {
	tag, err := uc.Tags.GetBySlug(ctx, slug)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return tag, nil
}
